craft_notes: Sthāyin: vismaya at groundless making. Device: end-dash→semicolon — canvas stated with weight, hail released clean. Bright: nothing, no wall, spreading canvas — the void itself luminous. Rejected: 'paint' for 'unfurl' — killed: citra spreads, unfurl keeps spreading. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Stocked with nothing, backed by no wall, they unfurl the world-canvas;
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirupādānasambhāram abhittāv eva tanvate jagaccitraṃ namas tasmai kalāślāghyāya śūline

reads_against.argmap: Provision without material; on no wall indeed, they extend the world-picture.; Bow to him, art-praised trident-bearer. → Bow to the trident-bearer extending the world-picture without ground.
c1_essence: Sthāṇu beyond minute and great; goose-power praised; groundless world-picture bowed.
